concept.material: brushed gunmetal steel and polished brass
concept.internal_detail: miniature gear train with interlaced escapement wheels
concept.button: a small brass cylinder protruding from the base
concept.button_short: the small brass cylinder at the base
concept.shell_mechanic: The faceted decagonal column slides apart along its vertical brass tracks and the ten outer segments rotate outward like miniature staves
concept.emerging_parts: A tiny brass cylinder pin drum and a polished comb with steel teeth
concept.signature_move: its brass cylinder rotates smoothly on its central axis and its steel comb plucks a tiny tune while its winding key twirls once around its arbor
concept.turkish: hand-cranked music box: Kurmali muzik kutusu (Kucuk, melodi calan mekanik kutu) — yuzeyli on gen sutun, fircalanmis silah celigi ve parlatilmis pirinc

concept.internal_detail: radiating copper wires and tiny rocking levers
concept.button: a copper rivet on the curved flank
concept.button_short: the copper rivet on the flank
concept.shell_mechanic: The copper dome separates into nested sections that slide backward along internal tracks
concept.emerging_parts: Two long jointed legs, a slim feathered tail strut, and a narrow pointed beak casing
concept.signature_move: its articulated metal tail feathers swing sharply up and down on their hinge, and its yellow glass eye lens pulses with a faint internal amber glow
concept.turkish: roadrunner: Yol kocari (Kuzey Amerika'da yasayan hizli kosucu kus) — oluklu eliptik kubbe, oksitlenmis bakir ve dovme demir

concept.material: heavy cast iron and weathered silver plate
concept.internal_detail: fine coiled linkages and miniature balance wheels
concept.button: a flush silver stud at the top edge

concept.signature_move: its broad silver pectoral fins pivot upward together on their hinges and tilt back down in a steady mechanical stroke
